approvedTreatment.visualThesis: One sale enters at full size, successive variable costs visibly remove value, and a strictly smaller remainder exits.
approvedTreatment.composition: One continuous left-to-right tabletop lane in a high three-quarter view, with separated cutting gates and side catch-trays fully visible above the subtitle-safe region.
mustShow: exactly one large coral sale block entering from the left
one continuous value block becoming physically smaller after each separated gate
a small removed coral fragment falling into a side catch-tray at every gate
exactly one final coral remnant in the output tray, visibly smaller than the input block
mustNotShow: multiple sale blocks or duplicate input tokens
a final tray containing more material than the input sale block
extra unaccounted blocks, decorative inventory, labels, arrows, numbers, currency symbols, logos, or readable text
a portrait-led composition or synthetic Veronica likeness
promptInstructions: Use strict visual conservation: total visible coral material after the gates must not exceed the single input block.
Make every removal mechanical and causal, with the remaining block visibly reduced at each gate.
Keep the final output tray isolated and containing only the one small retained remnant.
Use neutral wood and clear glass for stations so the coral value material is the only repeated semantic signal.

scope: Approve this exact source-grounded visual encoding for deterministic prompt materialization only; no provider call is authorized.
